sim1.note: Old tuning (900 fuel reserve, aimed at the pad). Boostback stopped at the reserve about 5 km short; the entry burn and glide added 7.5 km more. Soft, upright splashdown about 12.4 km east of the pad.

sim2.note: New tuning (650 reserve, aim 6 km past the pad). Boostback reached its aim point with 1,184 fuel left, no entry burn was needed, and the glide pulled the predicted impact from 5.5 km to 3.3 km past the pad. KSP crashed during the landing burn at about 1.1 km, so there is no touchdown.
sim2.result: KSP crashed in the landing burn at 1.1 km; heading for about 3.3 km west of the pad

sim3.note: Guidance put the predicted landing point 20 m from the pad. An Oh Scrap oxidizer leak at the start of the glide emptied the oxidizer; the engines starved 1 s into the landing burn with 1,240 liquid fuel left, and the booster hit the ground at about 150 m/s.
sim3.result: Lost: oxidizer leak starved the engines in the landing burn

sim4.note: New Kestrel booster (Prometheus-IIG-ACS control packs). Aim 2.5 km past the pad; the glide pulled it to 0.97 km, then the landing burn made no correction. First landing: upright and intact.
sim4.result: Landed upright 865 m from the pad, 830 fuel left

sim5.note: Falcon 9 Full Thrust Interstage RCS Units, flip with no engines, aim 1.5 km, landing-burn steering. The steering went dead for 45 s while the engines were idle, then pushed too hard near the ground: touched down at about 31 m/s sideways and tipped over. Fixed: grid fins steer until the engines are working, sideways speed capped by height.
sim5.result: Down 67 m from the pad, tipped over (31 m/s sideways)
